participants.analysis_operator: Seeks complete-cost after-tax profit while preserving current and future obligations.
participants.assay_supplier: Accepts only funded, scope-defined work covering its complete incremental costs and outside surplus.
participants.human_specialist: 100% human attention plus genuine conventional software; same data, algorithm and retained means allowed.
participants.investor_lender: Seeks acceptable discounted distributions, downside and dilution/control terms.
participants.research_lab: Chooses measured scientific decision value net complete outlay, attention and missed-target loss.
participants.same_algorithm_rival: May adopt the identical tool; no durable method exclusivity is assumed.

retained_obligations: Principal and restricted reserves are not expenses; future collections are unavailable before acceptance. Existing obligations and sunk research are retained.
